source_strategy: New university/archival profiles and signed original memoirs, avoiding already closed repeated routes. Individual original-body opportunities, not a statistical sample or source-blind preregistration.
admission: Full native identity and compatible source date precision plus distinguishing anchors; exact date preferred. Explicit birth clause required. Do not infer or replace native day from partial dates. Source date conflicts held. First birthplace can be accepted while geography unknown.
grade_roles: New person-birthplace support separate from DOB grades; S2 conservative for edited/original institutional narratives, weaker uncredited life notices S3 with explicit caveats.
quotes: <=25 English words per source; original fulltexts/raw PDFs stay scratch, not distributed.
